objective: Bring Noboru's Cudgel to the leader of The Harborage in the Swamp of Sorrows.

description: Noboru has plagued the Draenei of the Harborage for months, and his cudgel is a symbol of the brutality they have suffered at the hands of the lost ones.
progress: Greetings. And welcome to the Harborage.
completion: You have gained the weapon of the dreaded Noboru? Is he then dead?

This is a joyous day for the Harborage. Noboru and his gang were a terror to us, wandering the swamps and killing any Draenei who crossed his path. He was a direct threat to our survival, and we did not have the strength to face him.
We are fortunate to have a friend in you, <name>.
